Info: Down the Rabbit Hole
Info: Report for Duty
Speaker: Ballas
Speech: We swore to carry the sacred light of our dominion into the deepest dark, and this we have done! Swear now to defend this holy treaty alongside our blessed and brave creations: the Sentients of Tau.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Can you believe we used to be at war?

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Not joke, Tenno.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: It's just... insane. When all the time it could have been like this.

Speaker: Grineer Announcer
Speech: Guve me someklung to shoot. Ron't det garr guigrr rorn.
Speech: Give me something to shoot. Don't let your guard down.

Speech: Tray sharg, Hu rear someklung.
Speech: Stay sharp, I hear something.

Speaker: Grineer Announcer
Speech: Guve me someklung to shoot.
Speech: Give me something to shoot.

Info: View Tau System with Adis
Speaker: Adis
Speech: What your parents say, if they here?

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Oh, they'd invite you to dinner, then panic over what to feed you.

Info: Your parents?
Speaker: Operator
Speech: Did they ever tell you what happened to your ancestors?

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Making up the great Rail, was the telling. First you serve as labor. Then you serve as parts.

Info: Rematch?
Speaker: Operator
Speech: I've been working on some new moves. Gonna let me try them out on you?

Speaker: Adis
Speech: First we find new fighting place! We get caught, Grineer think war-times come again!

Info: Ready for your test?
Speaker: Operator
Speech: Anything you want to go over before Itzam grills you?

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Adis... maybe forgot Naramon principles section 8?

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Again? Okay, don't sweat it. I've got your back.

Info: Check on the New Hybrid Project
Speaker: Margulis
Speech: I trust Itzam over the Orokin. Have him report to me daily.

Speaker: Daklo
Speech: Disgusting, isn't it? Orokin gold - wasted! I wonder... which of you would this aberration attack first?

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Stupid.

Speaker: Daklo
Speech: Watch your mouth, void-lugger.

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: Ah, please, please, with me. The place for conflict is in the dojo.

Info: Follow Archimedean Itzam
Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: Adis Truth-Bloom, have you adapted to the Tenno Ways?

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: When the applications of Tauron are applied to Naramon's theories, what is the expected outcome?

Info: A new Somatic connection.
Speaker: Operator
Speech: A new Somatic connection.

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Uh, a Somatic connection new, power increase many?

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: No cheating! If you are tested by the Seven, we must show your evolution to their ways.

Info: A regression in stability.
Speaker: Operator
Speech: A regression in stability.

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Stability regress? Great badness?

Info: It's a trick question.
Speaker: Operator
Speech: It's a trick question.

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Cannot be done! You are tricking.

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: No cheating! Especially when the answer is grievously incorrect! Would you embarrass us so before the Seven?

Speaker: Operator
Speech: So... the Seven are coming?

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: The treaty is not as finished as we would wish. The conditions laid upen our stewardship -

Info: Get to the Airlock
Speaker: Apex Stentor
Speech: Anarch strike is underway! Tauron students, to deployment!

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Let's go, 'truth-bloom!'

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Adis did not choose name!

Speaker: Assignator Korffel
Speech: Well, praise the Void. You two managed to show up on time. Boro Overlook. Go. Now.

Info: Back to the Front
Info: Destroy Turrets
Speaker: Valdur
Speech: We're pinned down, Tenno. Can you give us a miracle?

Speaker: The Man in the Wall
Speech: That's the spirit, kiddo. Limb... from.. limb.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Shut up!

Speaker: Dax Anarch Lustratus
Speech: Back! Fall back!

Speaker: Prime Grineer
Speech: Tenno on sight.

Speaker: Prime Grineer
Speech: Stand tall.

Speaker: Prime Grineer
Speech: For the Orokin.

Speaker: Prime Grineer
Speech: Tenno... savior.

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Cast and cry, cast and cry
Speech: Raise the million pylons high
Speech: All our kin are bound to fly

Speaker: Conculyst Zin-Osku
Speech: Truth-Bloom!

Speaker: Valdur
Speech: COVERRRR!

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Ten-no!

Speaker: Operator
Speech: I see them.

Speaker: Valdur
Speech: That was the old Makvos cannon. Can you take it out?

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Trust the we.

Info: Locate Makvos Cannon
Speaker: Operator
Speech: Go charge up, Adis. I've got your back.

Speaker: Adis
Speech: You are authentic friend, Tenno.

Speaker: Valdur
Speech: 'Xenoflora'. Flowers. The only real alien life we've ever found, and the Sents scarf them down like kubrow chow! Just as well for us they did, eh, Tenno? Suddenly they've all got minds of their own, so no more hivemind, so no more war.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Ready?

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Tau fills me.

Speaker: Valdur
Speech: Take out that gun, Tenno. We're getting pounded!

Speaker: Anarch Galastra
Speech: Tantivy, ha! What say you all? Shall we enlighten this Tenno?

Speaker: Anarchs
Speech: Tantivy! Tantivy!

Speaker: Operator
Speech: The shields, Adis!

Speaker: Adis
Speech: I got it!

Info: Follow Adis
Speaker: Adis
Speech: Yarata! Now, Tenno!

Speaker: Valdur
Speech: Good work. This treaty's going to live, Galastra, and you don't get to tear it up. Dropships inbound!

Speaker: Anarch Galastra
Speech: Valdur. My old pet. Better count your flock again, dog, and keep your ships on the ground. Else I'll be set to carving your lost lamb.

Speaker: Sentient
Speech: Help me Adis!

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Hurry, Tenno!

Info: Rescue the Captured Sentient
Speaker: Adis
Speech: Bad place. Golden-cursed. Long-ago precepting.

Speaker: Anarch Galastra
Speech: No history taught in those Tenno schools? Peace cannot abide the machines.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: You're the only ones keeping this war alive.

Speaker: Anarch Galastra
Speech: Let me show you why.

Speaker: Adis
Speech: But... the blooms make us more than machine! Why does she hate?

Speaker: Anarch Galastra
Speech: A place to breathe.

Speaker: Sentient
Speech: Adis!

Speaker: Anarch Galastra
Speech: The promise of a home. So lightly surrendered.

Info: Note: this dialogue only occurs when observing a dead Summulyst with an orange hologram
Speaker: Sentient
Speech: Truth-Bloom!

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Coming, hive-kin!

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Let him go!

Speaker: Anarch Galastra
Speech: Of course! When he's good and ready, child. Sentient TQ-776VL! Repel intruders! So desperate for orders without your xenoflora.

Info: Subdue the Hostile Dactolyst
Speaker: Adis
Speech: Hive-kin, Adis will heal!
Speech: Cast and cry, cast and cry
Speech: Raise the million pylons high
Speech: All our kin are bound to fly
Speech: For that far shore forlorn

Speaker: Operator
Speech: I'm sorry! I didn't want to! It was him or me... him or me!

Speaker: Operator
Speech: I killed him, Lotus.

Speaker: The Man in the Wall
Speech: IVBOK AIO-UN KARIS, MARA LOHK!

Speaker: Loid
Speech: It knows.

Speaker: Lotus
Speech: Tenno! The truth of Tau must not be taken from us again. I need you to go back under, however briefly. If the danger becomes too great, in your mind or in this place, you will sense it.

Info: Too Far!
Speaker: Loid
Speech: 'Too far! Take it back!

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: And so you returned without Adis? Most unfortunate. Your, ah, patron has asked me to inquire about... the voices?

Speaker: Operator
Speech: The voices are under control.

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: Let us hope so. Now. What would you say is Galastra's goal?

Info: She's trying to restart the war by turning Sentients hostile.
Speaker: Operator
Speech: War. Using the Sentients as her tools.

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: A sound hypothesis. We know she can undo the liberating effect of the blooms.

Info: She wants Tau for herself and her followers.
Speaker: Operator
Speech: Tau. All of it. Just for her and her people.

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: To be promised land as a reward for fighting, only to see it given to the enemy... It must be bitter indeed.

Info: I don't know enough yet.
Speaker: Operator
Speech: There are still too many unknown factors.

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: Ah. the lament of the true Archimedean. 'Insufficient data'.

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: Your somatic readout indicates emotional stress. I am not judging you for what happened, Tenno. But we must find Adis.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: I know where he'll be.

Info: Find Adis
Speaker: Daklo
Speech: Tenno, I know you're loyal and you want this to work, but you know it as well as I do: there is something deeply amiss with the Sentients. If they're so proud of who they are, then why do they want to be human so badly? And every time they try, it's just off, isn't it? Just know you have a friend in me if you ever need to talk.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Adis?

Speaker: Operator
Speech: You lost something.

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Many things.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Yeah. Me too.

Speaker: Adis
Speech: I know.

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Let's not lose the We also.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Never. So, uh... do you wanna go hunting? With me?

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Always.

Info: Get to the Airlock
Speaker: Assignator Korffel
Speech: Hold up, Tenno. We just intercepted an Anarch transmission. Listen to this.

Speaker: Anarch Galastra
Speech: ...confirming debris field. The prey has gone to ground, my hunters. Tantivy!

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Adis, get on comms. We need intel. I'm going after them.

Info: Interrogation
Speaker: Adis
Speech: Tenno, go after ones with big shiny hat!

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Can you narrow it down?

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Lus-tra-tus? They lead. They know orders from Galastra. Make them tell!

Speaker: Anarch Capsarii
Speech: Loffler berries? Waste of good soil. Vineyards for me.

Speaker: Anarch Libritor
Speech: Tenno scorch the earth, none of us get nothing.

Speaker: Anarch Officer
Speech: This again, Braz?

Speaker: Anarch Capsarii
Speech: You know it's all done with drones and gas, right? Tenno don't exist.

Info: Interrogating 1st Lustratus
Speaker: Operator
Speech: What's Galastra hunting?

Speaker: Dax Anarch Lustratus
Speech: A shuttle... she has it shot down... the Makvos...

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Dax cannot defy Kuva. But Anarchs defy Orokin? How?

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Orokin houses clash all the time. Dax can kill troops, they just can't hurt the Golden Lords themselves.

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Maybe through hive-kin... they try to find a way?

Speaker: The Man in the Wall
Speech: Slice. Burn. Maim. We love it when you get to cut loose.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Shut. UP.

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Adis not talk.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Sorry. Talking to myself.

Info: Interrogating 2nd Lustratus
Speaker: Operator
Speech: How is Galastra controlling Sentients?

Speaker: Dax Anarch Lustratus
Speech: The xenoflora... without them, they revert to... to...

Speaker: Adis
Speech: With the blooms, Tau made us free. All know this.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: But what happens if you don't get them?

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Hunger. For orders. If none come... hivemind would return.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Gonna scramble this targeting array, Adis. That ought to bring a Lustratus out of hiding.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Okay. Codes.

Info: Interrogating 3rd Lustratus
Speaker: Operator
Speech: The downed shuttle. Where is it?

Speaker: Dax Anarch Lustratus
Speech: Perintol... crater!

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Need to redeploy, Adis!

Info: Fallen From Heaven
Speaker: Assignator Korffel
Speech: Back so soon?

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Galastra shot down a shuttle. She's got to be after the passengers.

Speaker: Assignator Korffel
Speech: If we can't keep the peace then this treaty's dead in the water. Get back down there, Tenno!

Speaker: Dax Anarch Lustratus
Speech: New orders incoming from Galastra. Stand by.

Speaker: Dax Anarch Lustratus
Speech: Tenno target is identified. Transmitting coordinates. Tantivy!

Speaker: Dax Anarch Lustratus
Speech: Distribution of rations has once again been delayed.

Speaker: Dax Anarch Lustratus
Speech: Burying parties are permitted to sell their armor and weapons.

Speaker: Dax Anarch Lustratus
Speech: All free Dax are entitled to a land claim. Speak to your commanding officer.

Speaker: Dax Anarch Lustratus
Speech: It is imperative that all free Dax nominate a beneficiary.

Speaker: Dax Anarch Lustratus
Speech: Correspondence delivered after the dated deadline will not be accepted.

Speaker: Dax Anarch Lustratus
Speech: We did not betray the Orokin. The Orokin betrayed us.

Speaker: Dax Anarch Lustratus
Speech: Honor can never be taken from you.

Speaker: Dax Anarch Lustratus
Speech: Those who can no longer fight may serve with honor as Yaskutai, or accept the Bitter Tea.

Speaker: Dax Anarch Lustratus
Speech: Cool water flows, the moon behind a cloud. To the receptive mind, all things come in time.

Speaker: Dax Anarch Lustratus
Speech: Sun at mid-heaven, sovereign above all. Mind in firm action commits without reflecting.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: This was a VIP transport. Whoever Galastra's hunting, they're Orokin.

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: Attention! Dignitary aboard! Atten... Identify yourself.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Tauron student, first class division M four dash A. By the glory and wisdom of the Seven I salute you.

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Void cloak emittings. Hidden Dax close. Careful, Tenno!

Info: Defeat Ambush
Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: Conveyance is under attack!

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: Your service is acknowledged. Escort the Executor to the extraction point.

Speaker: Adis
Speech: On board is who?

Speaker: Operator
Speech: One of the Seven!

Info: Escort the Executor to Safety
Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: We are sustaining unacceptable aggression!

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: Our passenger is in danger!

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: Dispatch these barbarians before they reave us apart!

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: Attention! We have been assaulted!

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: Hostility!

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: Another such assault and we are finished.

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: This vehicle is hanging on by the rivets!

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: Your defense is lamentable.

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: We are in tatters. How could you neglect your duty so?

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: If our passenger dies, the responsibility will be on your addled head.

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: Be aware that I am authorized to perform emergency Continuity to save Orokin lives, and you are the only potential Yuvan in the vicinity.

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: Stay close.

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: We cannot move faster without endangering our passenger.

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: We will not go one step further without your protection.

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: We're are you going?

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: We require an escort.

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: Too far.

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: How can you defend us from over there?

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: Hasten to our site if you please!

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Tenno. Decrypted transmission. Listen!

Speaker: Anarch Galastra
Speech: ... He'll come around, or he'll serve as an example...

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Keep monitoring, Adis. We need to know more.

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: Ugh, a barricade. How crude. Remove it.

Speaker: Palanquin
Speech: The terrain is treacherous. We must exercise caution. Be patient.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Adis... did... did your people do this?

Speaker: Adis
Speech: A devil-frame who did devil's work! He deserve this, Ten-no.

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Tenno! More transmission!

Speaker: Anarch Galastra
Speech: ... spill an Executor's guts with everyone watching, and not go to war on the spot? No. I know how the Orokin think. Once they see a Sentient disembowel an Executor, the treaty is as good as dead...

Speaker: Operator
Speech: That's her plan? She's insane.

Speaker: Anarch Galastra
Speech: Little Tenno. You are way out of your depth. Now the big fish are going to devour you. Sentient PV-22! Destroy the medical transport and kill the passenger!

Speaker: Operator
Speech: You...

Speaker: Ballas
Speech: Remember this.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Ballas!

Speaker: Lotus
Speech: Ballas is dead.

Speaker: Loid
Speech: I'm afraid the Murmur are coming. In numbers. Only a few automated defenses left between us and them. I'm trying to contact the Cavia, but...

Speaker: Tagfer
Speech: Mara lohk! Mara lohk!

Speaker: Lotus
Speech: They have reverted.

Speaker: Loid
Speech: Tenno. See reason! If the Indifference encroaches upon the equipment here, it could trap your mind and leave your body an empty husk!

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Seal the doors, Loid. I have to go deeper.

Info: Peace in His Hands
Info: Talk to Archimedean Itzam
Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: With the Seven split, Ballas held the casting vote. Peace is entirely in his hands, and the warmongers whisper in his ear day and night. Your presence may offend him.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: But I saved his life!

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: Orokin gratitude is like summer lightning: its light is fleeting merely, and wrath soon follows. Wait outside. I shall do what I can.

Speaker: Ballas
Speech: Wise Itzam. First of the Sentient Archimedeans. Speak.

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: It's Galastra, Executor. Her Anarchs now occupy every one of the known world-seeders. Many of our bloom nurseries lie in ashes! Tokh-Amn itself is threatened! We believe she may be receiving assistance. Executor Nitokh is helping.

Speaker: Ballas
Speech: The moon Perita is soon to be sovereign Sentient territory, per article 92. 'All Orokin forces to withdraw.' Remain and we violate the treaty, depart and we abandon a friend in need! What, then, would you have me do about Galastra?

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: I have spoken to my fellow Archimedean. Your... consort? It appears the world-seeders have a weakness.

Speaker: Ballas
Speech: Close the door.

Info: Get to the Airlock
Speaker: Assignator Korffel
Speech: Shake a leg. Adis and Itzam are waiting for you at Tokh-Amn.

Speaker: Assignator Korffel
Speech: Remember, this place is holy to them. So mind your manners.

Info: Eden's Ultimatum
Info: Follow Adis
Speaker: Operator
Speech: You were born here? It's beautiful.

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Amar! Amar!

Speaker: Bloom Guardian Amar
Speech: Amn-tavosh! Ma veren tokh-amn eet! Ma zid ik aran. Bar dakh.

Info: Attend Battlefield Graduation Ceremony
Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: When I told Executor Ballas of the peril Tokh-Amn was facing, I little thought he would place me in charge of its defense. In this sacred place, the minds that had begun to grow on our long journey finally flowered. Tenno, Adis, in the spirit of Tokh-Amn I bind your souls together. Be the example we look to, the living truth of peace. The two of you have already been tested deeply, beyond any grade or metric. I have nothing left to teach. I deem you both Tauron Adept. May your union never be sundered.

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: A graduation present from the lady herself.

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: Grineer! Excellent!

Speaker: Anarch Grineer
Speech: Target identified!

Speaker: Operator
Speech: They're not ours!

Speaker: Bloom Guardian Amar
Speech: Bar-lorun! Mo heekra!Defend here! I warn the others!

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Valdur? Respond!

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Valdur? Come in, damn it! You've got a rogue battalion down here!

Info: Keep Itzam Alive
Speaker: Valdur
Speech: Negative, Tenno. Those traitors were grown off-site.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: How??

Speaker: Valdur
Speech: A rogue Executor and her lapdog. We need to get Itzam out of there now. I'm sending a shuttle. You clear a landing zone!

Speaker: Lotus
Speech: backgroundAre they alive?

Speaker: Loid
Speech: backgroundBarely. Cataleptic state. Vitals marginal.

Speaker: Lotus
Speech: backgroundWhat do they see?

Speaker: Loid
Speech: backgroundNo way to tell without joining them, wherever they are.

Speaker: Valdur
Speech: Shuttle inbound. It's taken some hits. Just make sure it sets down in one piece.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Wait! We should help!

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: No time!

Speaker: Archimedean Itzam
Speech: Thank you, Tenno. You two have been a singular headache at times, but I admit I shall miss our classes. Perhaps you might consider returning next year, to speak to the new students.

Speaker: The Man in the Wall
Speech: Just can't keep them alive, can you, kiddo? Everyone who cares for you ends up dead.

Info: Down the Rabbit Hole
Speaker: Operator
Speech: Ready?

Speaker: Margulis
Speech: Galastra tried to steal the life of my love. For that alone she deserves death. But the complete extinction of the Tau blooms, which she plans to bring about, would hurl us back into a state of war. With the collusion of Executor Nitokh and her lackey Roathe, she has sequestered herself and her followers within the world-seeders, the armored Zariman Ova of old. But they have a flaw. A destruct sequence. This Ayatan holds the trigger codes. Deliver it to the world-seeder's heart and turn Galastra's fortress into her funeral pyre.

Info: Go to Deployment
Speaker: Prime Grineer
Speech: No admittance.

Speaker: Assignator Korffel
Speech: Give 'em hell for me, kid.

Info: Assault on Zariman Five-Nine
Speaker: Ballas
Speech: Your people faced extinction, you found wisdom, and now you rise. Peace is trembling in our hands. Let us boldly grasp it.

Speaker: Dax Anarch Lustratus
Speech: Void knows how, but they've found us!

Speaker: Anarch Galastra
Speech: Bring me my Ascaris!

Speaker: Anarch Galastra
Speech: You think... you are the only ones... to command the Frames?

Speaker: Adis
Speech: Control frames, but no Tenno? Galastra burn herself up for sure.

Speaker: Anarch Galastra
Speech: Play the wolf, Tenno. Cut down the suckling lamb and join the side that's going to win.

Speaker: Anarch Galastra
Speech: Peace isn't won with flowers and songs! You only get peace... through sacrifice!

Speaker: Anarch Galastra
Speech: I'm going to die on my estate, here on my moon, surrounded by weeping grandchildren and howling Kubrows. Not now. And not by your hand!

Speaker: Adis
Speech: What is happen?

Speaker: Operator
Speech: It's... me. I can't do this. I don't want to do this!

Speaker: Operator
Speech: Loid. What. No. You can't be here on Tau.

Speaker: Loid
Speech: You're not on Tau. This is a memory. It happened. And I'm so sorry, but we can't change any of it.

Speaker: Operator
Speech: But we're almost at the part where...

Speaker: Adis
Speech: It's okay. I'm here. My light goes with you. Always.

Speaker: Loid
Speech: We're losing them.

Speaker: Lotus
Speech: Bring them back!

Speaker: Loid
Speech: I can't! They've gone too deep!

Speaker: Loid
Speech: Murmur. Breaking the perimeter seals. Flooding the labs. It's over.

Speaker: Operator
Speech:             gulping water

Speaker: Lotus
